scripts.dev: bun run build:sidecar && bun run --filter aalai-native dev:app
scripts.check: concurrently --group --names biome,tsc:core,tsc:native,test,eval,rust,fallow --prefix-colors auto "bun run check:biome" "bun run check:tsc:core" "bun run check:tsc:native" "bun run check:test" "bun run check:eval" "bun run check:rust" "bun run check:fallow"
scripts.check:rust: bun run build:sidecar && cd app/native/src-tauri && cargo clippy --all-targets
scripts.check:fix: concurrently --group --names biome,rust --prefix-colors auto "biome check --write" "bun run fix:rust"
